name: Groxy AI Golden-Ratio Design-Craft & Visual Rhythm Playbook

line_measure.guidance: Add a line-measure token (for example --grex-measure: 62ch) via Grex Theme Builder's Global Token Editor.

surface_1.guidance: Add --grex-surface-1 in Light and Dark modes via Grex Theme Builder's Global Token Editor.

surface_2.guidance: Add --grex-surface-2 in Light and Dark modes via Grex Theme Builder's Global Token Editor.

rules.title: 8pt Spacing Rhythm via Live --grex-* Tokens
rules.description: All section, container, card, and grid gaps/padding map to the 8pt scale (4pt allowed only for tight inline pairs) using live --grex-* spacing tokens.

rules.title: 60-65ch Readable Body Copy Measure
rules.description: Body copy measure targets 60-65ch via a live measure token role. Missing measure tokens report token_unavailable rather than inventing tokens or hardcoding 65ch.

rules.title: One Primary CTA Per Fold
rules.description: Enforce at most one primary CTA per fold/section; extra primary CTAs are deterministically demoted to secondary.

rules.title: Light/Dark Surface Elevation & Dual-Theme Contrast
rules.description: Light and Dark panels/cards order --grex-surface-1 and --grex-surface-2 consistently and maintain WCAG AA >= 4.5:1 contrast in both themes.

rules.title: Full-Stack GrabLab CMS & ForEach Wiring
rules.description: Generated Form inputs and ForEach grids bind strictly to live GrabLab CMS content types and fields with exact ADR-025c base-10 wire strings and never fabricate form action URLs.
